summary: Lately the Board has been trying to fix in place the things that make this the Mission: it made the Carnaval Mural on South Van Ness a landmark in 2023, the Grand Theater on Mission Street the same year, and in 2025 affirmed the Mission Cultural Center for Latino Arts' right to return to 2868 Mission Street once the building has been retrofitted. It lends against new housing here on a scale few neighbourhoods match — $107 million for 168 flats at 1515 South Van Ness alone. A century earlier the same Board was licensing stables: Charles Scullion's three horses at 805 York Street in 1915, Evatt's two at 2707 Twenty-first Street in 1920.
